name: fork-ribbon-01
title: fork-ribbon-01
description: Fork me on GitHub corner ribbon — tones and corners via props.

files.content: "use client" import * as React from "react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" export type CornerRibbonTone = | "red" | "orange" | "green" | "black" | "navy" | "rose" export type CornerRibbonCorner = | "top-end" | "top-start" | "bottom-end" | "bottom-start" export type CornerRibbonProps = { className?: string /** Visible ribbon copy. Default keeps the classic fork line. */ label?: string href?: string tone?: CornerRibbonTone corner?: CornerRibbonCorner /** `absolute` for framed demos; `fixed` for live sites. */ position?: "fixed" | "absolute" title?: string } const TONE: Record = { red: "bg-[#a00]", orange: "bg-[#f80]", green: "bg-[#090]", black: "bg-[#333]", navy: "bg-[#0b1b33]", rose: "bg-[#be123c]", } /** * Classic corner ribbon (fork-ribbon geometry), rebuilt for React + logical corners. * Default label stays “Fork me on GitHub”. * * Stitch lines are absolute `top`/`bottom` children at 0.22em — identical on every corner. */ function CornerRibbon({ className, label = "Fork me on GitHub", href = "#", tone = "red", corner = "top-end", position = "absolute", title, }: CornerRibbonProps) { const isStart = corner === "top-start" || corner === "bottom-start" const isBottom = corner === "bottom-start" || corner === "bottom-end" // Mirror the classic CSS: top-end & bottom-start → +45°; top-start & bottom-end → -45°. const rotate = corner === "top-end" || corner === "bottom-start" ? "rotate-45" : "-rotate-45" return ( {label} ) } export { CornerRibbon, TONE }
